# Linear ticket template

**Title:** short, imperative ("Show monthly revenue chart on the overview page")

## Why
Who needs this and what it lets them do.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Observable outcome 1
- [ ] Observable outcome 2

## Journey
Which journey in `docs/journeys.md` this adds or changes, or "none".

## Out of scope
What the agent must not touch.

## Size
- `agent-ok`: small, autonomous. About 200 changed lines or fewer, 5 files or fewer, no protected paths. Gets auto-merged after the baseline period.
- No label: large. An engineer runs `plan` mode, the product owner approves the plan, then the engineer runs `build`.
